subject: SparkBridge joint field demo & co-marketing roadmap
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Alex D'Souza <alex@sparkbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: SparkBridge joint field demo & co-marketing roadmap

Alex —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Following up with a concrete proposal so we can lock dates and assets:

1) Roadshow concept: two-week field demo run in four cities (SF, Austin, NYC, London) with a 45-minute live demo + customer panel and a follow-up hands-on lab.
2) Joint assets: 1-pager for event landing page, co-branded slide deck, short case study pull-quote (sales-ready), and a shared registration form.
3) Ask from SparkBridge: event contact, ideal demo use-cases, one customer willing to join panel, and any preferred staff to co-present.
4) Timeline: planning sprint May 10–21; content lock May 28; first event pilot week of June 21.

Ben and Marissa — can you confirm field marketing capacity and whether the SF pilot (June 22–24) works? Irene, can you scope a short hands-on lab we can ship as a repo and runbook?

Attaching a rough deck outline and a one-sheet for event logistics. I suggest a quick internal working session this Wednesday (May 5) to assign owners.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
Head of Alliances
Redwood Inference
attachments: SparkBridge-deck-outline.pdf
From: Alex D'Souza <alex@sparkbridge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: partnerships@sparkbridge.com
Date: 2027-05-02T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SparkBridge joint field demo & co-marketing roadmap

Marcus —

Love this. SparkBridge is definitely up for a joint run. Quick notes from our side:
- Cities: SF and NYC are ideal; London is fine but would need local partner support (we have a rep in EMEA who can help).
- Customer panel: we can line up a current customer in fintech for SF.
- Legal: our procurement team will ask for a simple MOU that outlines branding and lead sharing rules. Can your legal review a draft?
- Budget: we usually cover local catering and booth staff; would like Redwood to co-sponsor flight/hotel for two presenters per city.

I've attached our standard event ratecard for planning. Jordan Lee from CloudWave (cc'd?) might be a good systems host for the hands-on lab — I'll intro if you want.

Best,
Alex D'Souza
Head of GTM Partnerships, SparkBridge
attachments: SBRG_ratecard.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Alex D'Souza <alex@sparkbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SparkBridge joint field demo & co-marketing roadmap

Alex — great, thanks for the clarity. Quick replies inline and a couple of asks:

- Cities: we can prioritize SF and NYC for the pilot and treat London as phase two (local rep support required).
- MOU: yes, please send the procurement contact and a draft; we'll run through Legal and send back a 1–2 page MOU for signatures.
- Budget: Redwood can cover co-sponsorship for two presenters per city; Ben, can you estimate a per-city budget (travel + booth + catering)?
- Hands-on lab host: Alex, please intro Jordan Lee if he's available — Irene will own the lab content and coordinate with their systems team.

Proposing an internal kickoff workshop Thursday May 6, 10:30–11:30 PT to map owners, content deadlines, and event checklist. I've attached a proposed scope doc.

Marcus
Head of Alliances
Redwood Inference
attachments: joint-demo-scope.docx

Date: 2027-05-03T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SparkBridge joint field demo & co-marketing roadmap

Marcus —

Thursday May 6 at 10:30 PT works for me. Ben and I did a quick triage on the scope doc and here are the immediate checklist items we should cover in the kickoff:

- Confirm pilot cities (SF, NYC) and exact dates per venue availability
- Draft MOU template (legal) and lead-sharing definition
- Registration page: who will own the CTA and form fields (we recommend Redwood own the registration to keep analytics consistent)
- Promo plan: 3-week email cadence, 2 blog swaps, social co-promo, and a post-event recording and short write-up
- Field budget: Ben to send a per-city budget estimate by EOD May 4
- Customer panel outreach: Marissa to own reaching out to SparkBridge-recommended contacts

I added the HubSpot opportunity link to the related_links. I'll also invite the field events PM and copy the vendor-approved AV list during the kickoff.

—Marissa
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: partnerships@sparkbridge.com
Date: 2027-05-03T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SparkBridge joint field demo & co-marketing roadmap

Marcus —

Thanks — Thursday works. Looping Jordan Lee <jordan@cloudwave.io> in a separate thread for the lab host intro.

Quick note on booth logistics: SparkBridge typically brings a 10x10 modular kit; will Redwood want co-branded signage or a shared backdrop? Happy to coordinate.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Alex
